summary: Phase 2 Online Member Self-Signup (iteration 216g Phase 2) backend testing complete. All 68 tests passed (41 Phase 2 + 27 Phase 1 regression). New endpoints (track, get-draft, recover, funnel) and journey scheduling all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Track endpoint correctly handles all event types (view, draft_started, step_*) and silently absorbs non-existent slugs to avoid breaking the page
Get draft endpoint correctly returns 404 for non-existent drafts and 410 for completed signups (member_id set)
Recover endpoint correctly validates HMAC tokens - bad signature returns 400, expired returns 400, non-existent draft returns 404
Funnel endpoint correctly requires master admin auth (403 for non-admin, 401 for no auth)
Funnel KPIs include all required fields: views, drafts_started, drafts_completed, paid, revenue_pence, view_to_draft_pct, draft_to_paid_pct
Journey jobs collection is properly integrated into funnel response with status counts
Phase 1 endpoints (branding, plans, draft, parq, checkout, stripe-connect) all still working - no regressions
seed_data_creation: Test drafts created with unique UUIDs during testing (no cleanup needed - test isolation)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 Online Member Self-Signup backend fully tested. All 4 NEW endpoints tested: POST /api/public/signup/{slug}/track (anonymous funnel tracking), GET /api/public/signup/{slug}/draft/{draft_id} (magic-link recovery pre-fill), GET /api/public/signup/recover/{token} (HMAC token verification with redirect), GET /api/master-admin/signups/funnel (KPI panel with days/org filters). Journey jobs scheduling verified via funnel endpoint. Abandoned cart scan verified not crashing. Phase 1 endpoints regression tested - all working.

phase2_new_endpoints: POST /api/public/signup/{slug}/track - anonymous, accepts view/draft_started/step_* events, silently absorbs non-existent slugs
GET /api/public/signup/{slug}/draft/{draft_id} - anonymous, returns draft for magic-link pre-fill, 404 if missing, 410 if completed
GET /api/public/signup/recover/{token} - anonymous, verifies HMAC token, redirects 302/307 to join page with draft+token params

GET /api/master-admin/signups/funnel - master admin only, returns kpis (views, drafts_started, drafts_completed, paid, revenue_pence, view_to_draft_pct, draft_to_paid_pct), recent[], by_org[], journey_jobs{}
token_verification_tests: Valid token redirects to join page with draft and token params
funnel_tests: days=7 and days=30 query parameters work
journey_jobs field present with status counts
e2e_tests: Track view increments funnel views count
Full flow: draft → parq → checkout (fails at payment without Stripe)

mocked_apis_list: Resend email sends — RESEND_API_KEY is real but tests verify behavior without checking actual email delivery
Stripe Connect Express webhooks — only construct_event is wired; full webhook events not simulated

notes: The welcome journey worker runs on a 60s background loop. For tests, journey job creation is verified via the funnel endpoint's journey_jobs field. The abandoned cart scan runs as part of the worker loop and was verified not to crash by checking the funnel endpoint still works.
